AppliedTactic:
have : ∀ ε > 0, |a - b| < ε := by
      -- ⭐️ 任意に ε > 0 をとると、x_n → a かつ x_n → b から、
      intro ε εpos
      -- ⭐️ あるn₁, n₂で n ≥ n₂ → |x_n - a| < ε/2
      have n₁eps := xlima (ε / 2) (by exact half_pos εpos)
      let ⟨n₁,n₁h⟩ := n₁eps
      -- ⭐️ n ≥ n₂ → |x_n - b| < ε/2 をみたすものがある。
      have n₂eps := xlimb (ε / 2) (by exact half_pos εpos)
      let ⟨n₂,n₂h⟩ := n₂eps
      -- ⭐️ 従って n ≥ max {n₁, n₂} とすれば、
      let n := max n₁ n₂
      have : n ≥ max n₁ n₂ := by rw [ge_iff_le]
      -- ⭐️ |a - b| = |(a - x_n) + (x_n - b)| ≤ |x_n - a| + |x_n - b| < ε/2 + ε/2 = ε となる.
      calc
        |a - b| = |(a - x n) + (x n - b)| := by
          rw [add_sub,sub_add_cancel]
        _ ≤  |x n - a| + |x n - b| := by
          rw [abs_sub_comm]
          exact abs_add (a - x n) (x n - b)
        _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := (add_lt_add (n₁h n (le_of_max_le_left this)) (n₂h n (le_of_max_le_right this)))
        _ = ε := add_halves  ε

sub_add_cancel : In an additive group, subtracting an element from another and then adding the subtracted element back yields the original element.

add_sub : In a structure with addition and subtraction, adding the difference of two elements to a third element is equivalent to adding one element to the third and then subtracting the second element.

abs_sub_comm : This theorem asserts that the absolute value of the difference between two elements is symmetric, meaning that the order of subtraction does not affect its absolute value in the context of a lattice and additive group.
Max.max : A function computes the maximum of two elements from a specified type.

abs_add : This theorem states that in a linear ordered additive group, the absolute value of the sum of two elements is less than or equal to the sum of their absolute values, embodying the triangle inequality.
add_lt_add : This theorem asserts that the sum of two lesser pairs of elements is less than the sum of their respective greater pairs, given that each pair maintains a strict inequality.
le_of_max_le_left : If the maximum of two elements is less than or equal to a third element, then at least one of those two elements must also be less than or equal to the third element.
add_halves : This theorem asserts that in a linear ordered semifield, the sum of half of any element and half of the same element equals the original element itself.
ge_iff_le : The relation of one element being greater than or equal to another is equivalent to the latter being less than or equal to the former.
le_of_max_le_right : If the maximum of two elements is less than or equal to a third element, then the second element is also less than or equal to that third element.
